verdict.rationale: CockroachDB's 'Cockroach Continuum' feature explicitly targets this use case, describing cluster virtualization that lets 'application developers and agents deploy virtual clusters on a dedicated host cluster,' and ccloud CLI plus Request-Unit scale-to-zero billing support programmatic, cost-elastic cluster management. However, there is no concrete evidence of per-tenant/per-agent database creation at scale (thousands), pricing at that granularity, or API/CLI examples for bulk provisioning of isolated databases. Missing for 10: concrete API/CLI examples for programmatically spinning up many isolated databases, pricing/cost data at thousand-database scale, and independent/hands-on confirmation of Continuum's agent-oriented workflow.
